objective.summary: Turn the existing frontend Playwright estate into an explicit reliability-first execution program that gates release confidence on page-load health, primary interactions, and core business behavior.

execution_principles.principle: Prefer the smallest targeted E2E bundle that proves the touched functionality is operational.
Escalate from smoke to business-path suites when the surface under change affects create/read, billing bridge, forecast storefront, admin operations, or fallback semantics.
Keep the canonical Docker wrapper in the loop so environment health checks remain part of every reliability proof.
When a regression is a crash/500/runtime break, first land a failing reproduction in Playwright, then fix, then rerun the targeted profile until green.
Preserve coverage expansion as follow-on work, but do not block reliability execution on broader coverage initiatives.

workstream.goal: Freeze the reliability execution ladder and bundle selection strategy for frontend work.

tasks.task: Use `./scripts/run_e2e.sh --last-failed` as the fastest rerun path when relevant failures already exist.

Use the smoke bundle `e2e/admin.smoke.spec.ts e2e/core-ux.spec.ts e2e/report-create.spec.ts e2e/quality.spec.ts` before declaring broad frontend reliability regained for shared shell/create/admin changes.
For route-specific work, select the minimal impacted spec file or `-g` case that proves the fixed interaction/business path.
Include `e2e/route-console.spec.ts` or equivalent signal guard whenever the change could hide runtime errors behind a loaded page.

workstream.goal: Keep the highest-traffic user-facing surfaces functionally reliable.

tasks.task: Maintain landing/start/home/history/profile navigation reliability through `e2e/core-ux.spec.ts`, `e2e/landing.spec.ts`, `e2e/history-cta.spec.ts`, and profile-related specs as applicable.

Maintain create/report submission and read continuation through `e2e/report-create.spec.ts`, `e2e/report-workflow.spec.ts`, and read-surface suites such as `e2e/today-daybrief.spec.ts` or year/ten-year read specs as applicable.

Maintain week/today functional reliability and fallback semantics through `e2e/today-daybrief.spec.ts`, `e2e/week-page-fallback.spec.ts`, `e2e/week-home-refresh.regression.spec.ts`, `e2e/week-live.spec.ts`, and `e2e/week-fallback.regression.spec.ts` as applicable.

workstream.goal: Ensure revenue-critical and entitlement-sensitive flows are verified as business paths, not just page loads.

tasks.task: Use storefront/bridge suites such as `e2e/billing-mock.spec.ts`, `e2e/billing-catalog-alignment.spec.ts`, `e2e/month-forecast-bridge-storefront.spec.ts`, `e2e/year-forecast-bridge-storefront.spec.ts`, `e2e/solar-return-bridge-storefront.spec.ts`, and `e2e/synastry-bridge-storefront.spec.ts` when checkout/continuation semantics can change.
Use `e2e/report-failure.spec.ts` and route-specific fallback suites whenever a change touches guarded error states or graceful-degradation behavior.
Use `e2e/localization.spec.ts` or `e2e/forecast-realdata.spec.ts` only when the touched slice changes those semantics directly.

workstream.goal: Keep operator-critical surfaces ready for smoke and targeted admin checks.

tasks.task: Use `e2e/admin.smoke.spec.ts` as the minimum admin gate.

Escalate to `e2e/admin.users.spec.ts`, `e2e/admin.clients.spec.ts`, `e2e/admin.entitlements.spec.ts`, `e2e/admin.operations.spec.ts`, `e2e/admin.diagnostics.spec.ts`, `e2e/admin.rbac.spec.ts`, and natal-master admin specs when those domains are touched.

workstream.goal: Continue growing functional confidence where reliability-critical paths lack an explicit, minimal Playwright proof.

tasks.task: Add narrowly scoped E2E coverage for any newly discovered crash, broken interaction, or broken continuation path not already captured by existing files.
As suites evolve, keep bundle ownership clear so smoke, route, and business-path responsibilities do not blur.
Feed uncovered-but-critical paths into later coverage/hardening work without changing the reliability-first gate definition in this slice.

wave.title: Freeze Reliability Gate
wave.scope: Document and adopt the canonical frontend reliability ladder and bundle selection rules.

exit_criteria.item: Worker can map a touched page/flow to a specific targeted Playwright command set.
Smoke versus business-path escalation rules are explicit and reusable.

wave.title: Harden Core Page Loads and Interactions
wave.scope: Use targeted fixes and E2E proofs to keep high-traffic routes loading cleanly and responding to primary interactions.

exit_criteria.item: Changed surfaces have passing targeted E2E verification showing load plus primary interaction success.
Any crash/500 regression has a reproduction test that now passes.

wave.title: Harden Business Paths and Admin Operations
wave.scope: Verify create/read, billing bridge, fallback, and admin operator flows with targeted business-path suites.

exit_criteria.item: Revenue-critical or operator-critical changes are proven by business-path suites, not just generic smoke.
Signal-hygiene checks remain green for slices where runtime failure masking is plausible.

do_not_expand_into.path: Unrelated backend business logic unless the frontend failure cannot be reproduced or fixed without it.
Broad coverage-tool migrations or threshold programs that belong to separate hardening initiatives.
Unscoped visual-polish work without direct reliability impact.

required_report_back.item: Which reliability dimension was proven: load, interaction, business path, signal hygiene.
Any remaining gaps or deferred follow-on tests.
